correctness.rationale: The four-term F submodularity slack is J(S)+J(S+ef)−J(S+e)−J(S+f), with common 1/μ terms cancelling and positive product denominator. Independently constructed all 64 characteristic polynomials using traces of Laplacian powers and Newton identities, rather than the supplied Leibniz code. Over all 240 unordered pair/base-set tests, the numerator is the asserted exceptional factorization once, identically zero 29 times, and strictly positive on μ≥5/4 by nonnegative shifted coefficients and positive constant 210 times. The least such constant after multiplying by 4^15 was 2607034601472000. The quartic changes sign between 5/4 and 13/10 and has exactly one positive root by Descartes' rule. Its numerator has the quartic's sign for μ>0, including equality at the root. At zero screening p′(0)/p(0) is the pseudoinverse trace; on the {24} witness the four traces are 8/3, 41/20, 41/20, 146/105, giving slack −3/70. Replay: python3 /workspace/evidence/p5_newton.py. The supplied script was inspected, not run.
residual_risks: This is an exhaustive proof only for the specified unit, homogeneous-screening P5 instance.
